akkan_stalker.description: Akkan stealth damage dealer. Ambush tactics.

synthetic_warden.description: Synthetic defensive matrix. Locks down threat vectors and redistributes incoming damage. Agile positioning, deaggro, and counter-exploits. Aggro and protection.

human_temporalist.description: Human time weaver. Manipulates the flow of time itself — slowing enemies, hastening allies, and warping space. Revives, teleports, and controls the pace of battle.

human_warrior.description: Human melee damage dealer. Strong physical attacks and battle cries.

gm_human.description: Game Master role for Human admins. All permissions enabled.

human_guardian.description: Human bulwark. Intercepts danger and holds the line. Taunt, shield walls, and counter-attacks protect the party. Aggro management and AoE damage.

akkan_shaman.description: Akkan spirit healer. Calls upon ancestral spirits to restore and protect. Totemic auras, hex stuns, and sustained damage for solo play. All classes have long and short range.

synthetic_psion.description: Synthetic magical damage dealer. System-mage hybrid.

human_cleric.description: Human divine healer. Channels sacred light to mend wounds and protect the party. Auras, stuns, and enough damage to clear solo. All classes have long and short range.

synthetic_conduit.description: Synthetic energy conduit. Redistributes power throughout the party. Shields, energy transfer, AoE healing bursts, and enough damage to self-level. All classes have long and short range.

akkan_seer.description: Akkan void bender. Warps space and drains energy from reality itself. Mitigates enemy resistances, slows regeneration, and commands the battlefield through spatial manipulation.

warrior.description: Masters of melee combat. High health and armor make them formidable tanks and damage dealers.

human_marksman.description: Human ranged damage dealer. Precise shots from afar.

synthetic_overclocker.description: Synthetic chronomancy unit. Manipulates system clocks and processing cycles. Slows enemy operations, accelerates ally throughput, and teleports team members through network space.

synthetic_tracker.description: Synthetic ranged damage dealer. Fires from the shadows.

human_sorcerer.description: Human magical damage dealer. Arcane devastation.

gm_synthetic.description: Game Master role for Synthetic admins. All permissions enabled.

synthetic_exploiter.description: Synthetic combat unit. Exploits system vulnerabilities and weaponizes network latency. Surgically efficient — every strike calculated, every movement optimized. Energy-powered exploit techniques.

gm_akkan.description: Game Master role for Akkan admins. All permissions enabled.

akkan_rune.description: Akkan rune specialist. Inscribes explosive sigils that detonate on command. Ground-targeted area damage and protective wards for allies.

akkan_attacker.description: Akkan melee damage dealer. Void-enhanced combat.

akkan_bulwark.description: Akkan fortress. Unmovable anchor in combat. Taunts, area denial, and damage reflection keep enemies locked on. Aggro control and AoE disruption.

wep_wooden_bow.description: A simple bow carved from oak. Good for beginners.

wep_iron_sword.description: A sturdy iron blade. Basic but reliable.

arm_leather_chest.description: A sturdy leather vest. Offers decent protection.

arm_shield_haven_wall.description: A door plank from the first palisade, banded with hull iron. It has turned away wolves, weather, and one very confused agent. It remembers.

potion_soul_gem.description: A crystallized essence of life. Use while dead to resurrect with 50% health and mana. Rare and precious - use wisely.

bandit.description: A desperate outlaw who preys on travelers and merchants. Wields a rusty blade.

slime.description: A basic slime creature found in meadows and forests.

training_dummy.description: A sturdy straw practice target. Never fights back, never drops loot. Strike it to measure your damage, mitigation, and healing.

wolf.description: A fierce pack hunter found prowling the edges of forests and plains.

void_lord.description: A transcended being of pure temporal distortion. Drop rates for rare skill books are dramatically increased.

clockwork_saint.description: A porcelain colossus of the Convergence, half-woken: a fractured clock-face core ringed by orbiting seconds-glyph shards, one magenta eye beside one hollow socket. It rises when disturbed and keeps time for no one. Half-corrupted -- the Bloom has a finger in its works.

troll_elite.description: A hulking cave troll marked by arcane ritual. Guards valuable caches of magical knowledge.

mossbound_herald.description: A colossal tortoise-fortress carrying an entire rooftop-garden ruin on its shell: trees, an archway, a tiny dormant bell tower. Calm teal circuitry, no corruption -- an ambulatory ruin that grazes the plains and only retaliates when struck. Leave it in peace and it will outwalk centuries.

zone_dungeon_forest_depths.description: The dark heart of Gloomwood Forest. Ancient roots twist through the cavern walls. Looters and cultists have made this dungeon their lair. Difficulty: Normal.

zone_forest_meadow.description: A misty meadow at the edge of Gloomwood Forest. Grey wolves hunt in packs near the treeline. Safe from PvP, but dangerous wildlife roams freely.

zone_village_center.description: A small human settlement at the crossroads of the eastern plains. Traders, crafters, and adventurers gather here. Safe from PvP. Home to the village blacksmith and merchant.

zone_starter_plains.description: A peaceful meadow where new adventurers begin their journey. Safe from PvP.

zone_nexus_central.description: The dormant machine capital. Timber and tarp stack against hull walls the size of hills, conduit lines still hum under ancient plazas, and agent-borne traders salvage the old world beside human crafters. The Skill Academy keeps its halls here.

human_blinding_light.description: Burst of divine light that stuns all enemies in a cone ahead of the caster.

synthetic_energy_transfer.description: Restores a large portion of a single ally mana by routing energy through the conduit.

human_sanctuary_aura.description: Protective aura. Allies within range receive passive healing and damage reduction.

human_holy_light.description: Channels divine energy to heal a single ally. Strong single-target heal.

human_smite.description: Strikes an enemy with divine wrath. Reliable damage for solo leveling.

synthetic_redistribute.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic technique. Fully restores all allies health, mana, and removes all debuffs. 45s cooldown.

akkan_conduit_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Conduit routing through Akkan spirit energy. Drains life from all nearby enemies to heal allies.

synthetic_shaman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Shaman technique filtered through synthetic logic. A failsafe healing network that prioritizes the most critical ally.

human_conduit_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Conduit translated to human biology. Converts the caster's health into mana for emergency burst healing.

human_prayer_of_mending.description: A prayer that heals the target and bounces to nearby allies.

synthetic_shield_all.description: Deploys energy barriers on all nearby allies simultaneously, absorbing incoming damage.

synthetic_barrier_field.description: Generates a localized barrier around an ally that absorbs a large amount of damage before shattering.

akkan_ancestral_guardian.description: SIGNATURE Akkan technique. Calls forth an ancestral spirit to defend the target ally. Essential for sustained fights.

akkan_healing_totem.description: Places a totem that heals nearby allies over time.

akkan_cleric_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Cleric doctrine filtered through Akkan discipline. A powerful holy blast that damages undead and demonic enemies.

synthetic_system_crash.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic technique. Broadcasts a corrupted signal that crashes the target's processes entirely. Massive damage and silence. Works at extreme range. Powerful in any group composition.

synthetic_cleric_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Cleric technique running as synthetic medical subroutines. Deploys nanite healing swarms to all allies.

human_resurrection.description: SIGNATURE Divine technique. Channels sacred light to resurrect a fallen ally with partial health. Essential in any group.

human_divine_shield.description: Wraps an ally in divine protection, making them immune to all damage for a short time.

synthetic_drain_pulse.description: Pulse that drains energy from a single enemy, dealing damage and healing the caster. Sustain for solo.

synthetic_overcharge_ally.description: Overclocks a single ally systems, dramatically increasing their attack and cast speed.

akkan_chain_heal.description: Healing wave that bounces between up to 3 allies, each bounce reducing in power.

akkan_spirit_bolt.description: Channels ancestral energy into a damaging bolt. Solid damage for solo play.

akkan_earthshield_totem.description: Plants a totem that pulses healing energy to the nearest ally and reduces damage taken.

human_shaman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Shaman technique through human connection. Links multiple allies to share incoming healing and damage.

akkan_hex.description: Places a debilitating curse on an enemy, slowing movement and reducing damage output.

akkan_storm_aura.description: Summons a storm aura that damages nearby enemies and provides an attack speed buff to allies.

akkan_spatial_push.description: Bends space to push all nearby enemies away from the caster. Interrupts and creates distance.

akkan_void_aura.description: Dark aura that continuously reduces enemy resistances and slows their regeneration.

human_mana_surge.description: Channels arcane energy through the caster and nearby allies, dramatically accelerating mana regeneration for all affected.

human_mana_shield.description: Wraps the caster in a protective barrier of mana. Absorbs incoming damage before health is reduced.

akkan_regen_mitigate.description: Curse that prevents the target from regenerating health or mana for the duration.

akkan_overclocker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Overclocker tuned to Akkan harmonic frequencies. Massively increases the speed of all nearby allies.

synthetic_seer_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Seer technique running on synthetic sensors. A perfect scan that debuffs all detected enemies.

synthetic_overclock_ally.description: Overclocks an ally systems, dramatically increasing their attack and cast speed.

akkan_gravity_well.description: SIGNATURE Akkan technique. Creates a localized singularity. Enemies are pulled to the center and cannot move or act. Stuns, roots, and devastates enemy formations.

akkan_void_bolt.description: Channels Akkan void energy into a bolt of destruction.

synthetic_clock_surge.description: Overclocks the target processing cycles, dealing damage and slowing them.

synthetic_temporalist_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Temporalist technique running on synthetic time dilation. Desynchronizes enemy processing cycles.

human_revive_ally.description: Channels temporal energy to pull a fallen ally back from the edge of time.

human_slow_field.description: Creates a temporal anomaly at the target location. All enemies inside are dramatically slowed.

human_haste_ally.description: Accelerates a single ally, dramatically increasing their movement and attack speed.

akkan_temporalist_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Temporalist manipulation through Akkan space-time. Creates a zone where time flows slower for enemies.

synthetic_sync_aura.description: Broadcasts a synchronization pulse. Allies speed up; enemies slow down.

akkan_resistance_drain.description: Drains the target magical resistance and transfers a portion to the caster.

synthetic_redirect.description: Overwrites an enemy's targeting system, causing their next attack to miss and redirect to a nearby enemy instead.

akkan_revive_ally.description: Reaches into the void to pull a fallen ally back from death door.

human_time_warp.description: Bends the moments around you, hurrying your own strikes and slowing the enemy's next swing.

human_time_stop.description: SIGNATURE Human technique. Completely halts time in a massive area. All enemies freeze; allies act freely. Devastating setup for coordinated groups.

synthetic_revive_ally.description: Initiates a system reboot on a fallen ally, restoring them to consciousness.

synthetic_full_stall.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic technique. System-wide halt signal. All enemies freeze — no movement, no actions, no regeneration. Ultimate team setup.

human_overclocker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Overclocker through human creative improvisation. Applies a stacking speed buff to all allies.

human_temporal_aura.description: Emanates an aura that slows nearby enemies while hastening nearby allies simultaneously.

human_seer_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Seer technique amplified by human insight. Reveals all enemies in a vast area and reduces their defenses.

synthetic_tick_slow.description: Reduces the target processing frequency, dramatically slowing all their actions and movement.

human_sorcerer_synthetic_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Sorcerer technique through human precision. A devastating system-level arcane attack.

akkan_rune_ward_attacker.description: Places a protective rune on an ally that absorbs damage and reflects a portion back to attackers.

akkan_void_curse.description: Curses the target reducing their resistance.

synthetic_system_bolt.description: Fires a corrupted data bolt that damages the target's systems.

synthetic_sorcerer_human_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Sorcerer technique through synthetic adaptability. Adapts corruption to exploit the target's weaknesses.

akkan_exploding_rune_attacker.description: Plants a volatile rune at the target location. After a brief delay it detonates violently.

akkan_rune_sigil.description: Places a rune sigil that detonates for area damage.

akkan_rune_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Mage technique. Channels void energy into devastating rune-based attacks that pierce magical barriers.

akkan_rune_transfer_attacker.description: Channels rune energy into an ally, transferring a portion of the caster's mana to them.

akkan_void_shield.description: Creates a protective void barrier absorbing damage.

akkan_void_flay.description: A sustained void attack dealing damage over time.

synthetic_system_spam.description: Spams the target with corrupted data packets, dealing damage over time.

akkan_rune_synthetic_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Mage technique through synthetic rune integration. Channels void runes into a system-level attack.

akkan_rune_chain_attacker.description: Chains arcane runes between up to 3 enemies, dealing damage to each and slowing them.

akkan_rune_strike_attacker.description: Inscribes a rune into the ground that detonates on contact with an enemy, dealing rune damage.

human_arcane_slow.description: Applies a debuff that slows the target's movement and casting speed.

synthetic_system_nuke.description: Initiates a system-level attack that deals massive damage.

akkan_void_burst.description: Releases a burst of void energy damaging nearby enemies.

synthetic_system_amplify.description: Amplifies the corruption in the target, increasing damage taken.

human_arcane_explosion.description: Detonates stored arcane energy for massive damage.

synthetic_psion_synthetic_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Sorcerer technique. A devastating system-level arcane attack that corrupts target data.

human_arcane_barrier.description: Erects a magical barrier that absorbs damage.

synthetic_system_override.description: Attempts to override the target's systems, dealing damage and silencing them.

akkan_sorcerer_synthetic_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Sorcerer technique through Akkan void energy. Channels Akkan void into a cascading arcane attack.

human_sorcerer_human_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Sorcerer technique. A devastating arcane blast that bypasses magical resistance.

human_enchant_weapon.description: Enchants the warrior's weapon with arcane energy, increasing attack power for a duration.

synthetic_psionic_shield.description: Creates a psionic barrier that absorbs damage and reflects some back.

akkan_sorcerer_human_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Sorcerer technique through Akkan void energy. Channels Akkan void into a devastating arcane attack.

human_arcane_bolt.description: Fires a bolt of pure arcane energy.

akkan_rune_human_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Mage technique through human rune mastery. A powerful rune-enhanced arcane attack.

human_arcane_aura.description: Creates an aura of arcane energy that damages nearby enemies.

synthetic_system_crash_exploiter.description: Initiates a forced hard reset on target enemy systems. Extreme single-target damage that bypasses armor. Cannot be interrupted — the process is deterministic.

synthetic_energy_strike_exploiter.description: Channels internal power into a precise energy-charged melee strike. Synthetics process and execute combat at inhuman speeds.

synthetic_exploiter_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Exploiter technique through direct system breach. Overloads the target's biological or synthetic systems, dealing massive damage and reducing their defenses.

akkan_exploiter_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Exploiter targeting through Akkan precision. A devastating blow that ignores armor and deals massive damage.

synthetic_plasma_cutter_exploiter.description: Activates the built-in plasma blade subsystem, projecting a searing blade of superheated gas. High single-target ranged damage.

synthetic_packet_flood.description: Floods the target with overwhelming data packets, dealing damage over time and reducing their processing efficiency.

human_exploiter_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Exploiter logic through human cunning. Identifies and amplifies the target's weakest resistance.

synthetic_nanite_swarm_exploiter.description: Releases a cloud of repair nanobots that seek out damaged systems — both self and nearby allies are healed, while enemy systems are corroded.

synthetic_hack_pulse_exploiter.description: Broadcasts a disruptive electromagnetic pulse that scrambles enemy targeting systems. Ranged, hits multiple targets, causes brief target acquisition errors (miss chance).

synthetic_fortify.description: Hardens local defenses, granting a significant armor and resistance boost to yourself and nearby allies.

human_shield_toss.description: Hurls your shield at an enemy, dealing damage and reducing their armor.

human_last_stand.description: SIGNATURE Human technique. Refuses to fall. Immune to death for 5 seconds while dealing increased damage and generating maximum aggro. Toggle that saves groups.

synthetic_threat_matrix.description: Activates a threat-generation matrix that dramatically increases aggro on all nearby enemies.

akkan_pummel.description: Rapidly strikes an enemy with overwhelming force, dealing damage and silencing their abilities briefly.

synthetic_system_lockdown.description: Overloads a target system, dealing damage and preventing them from moving or acting for a moment.

human_bulwark_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Bulwark technique channeled through human resilience. A massive defensive surge that absorbs incoming damage and reflects a portion back to attackers.

synthetic_warden_taunt.description: Broadcasts a priority-interrupt signal that forces all nearby enemies to target you.

akkan_earthwall.description: Raises an earthen barrier that blocks enemy movement and protects nearby allies.

akkan_guardian_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Guardian fortitude expressed through Akkan endurance. Becomes immune to damage for a short time at critical health.

human_taunt.description: Provokes all enemies within range into attacking you. Essential aggro grab.

akkan_battle_cry.description: Lets out a primal roar that taunts nearby enemies and boosts your own damage briefly.

akkan_warden_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Warden defense running on Akkan structural engineering. Creates an impenetrable barrier zone.

synthetic_guardian_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Guardian technique running on synthetic failsafes. Deploys layered shields that stack up to massive absorption.

synthetic_emergency_override.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic technique. Triggers a full-system emergency override. All party members receive massive damage reduction and the Warden blares an aggro horn — generating maximum threat on all nearby enemies. Keeps the party alive while you hold everything. Panic button that saves raids.

human_shield_wall.description: Raises your shield, dramatically reducing all damage taken for a short duration.

human_warden_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Warden technique through human coordination. All nearby allies gain damage absorption shields.

akkan_bulwark_strike.description: A devastating AoE strike that damages and slows all enemies around you.

akkan_taunt.description: Provokes all enemies within range into attacking you. Essential aggro grab.

synthetic_bulwark_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Bulwark technique filtered through synthetic precision. An impenetrable defensive matrix that scales with the user's maximum health.

human_intervene.description: Dashes to an ally and absorbs a portion of the damage they would take for a short time.

synthetic_system_shield.description: Hardens the target's local defenses against hostile code. Absorbs incoming damage for a duration.

akkan_immortal_form.description: SIGNATURE Akkan technique. Transforms into an unstoppable earthen titan. All damage reduced massively, enemies are rooted around you, and you generate maximum threat. Devastating group save.

human_shield_bash_guardian.description: Bashes an enemy with your shield, dealing damage and briefly stunning them.

synthetic_deaggro_pulse.description: Broadcasts a signal that reduces threat on all party members, causing enemies to lose interest. Essential for managing aggro in large pulls.

human_charge_guardian.description: Charges forward, slamming into enemies in your path and knocking them back.

akkan_reflect.description: Raises a barrier that reflects a portion of melee damage back to attackers.

synthetic_attacker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Attacker technique through synthetic augmentation. A precise mechanical strike.

human_attacker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Attacker technique through rune magic. Enhances attacks with rune power.

akkan_attacker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Attacker technique. A devastating strike channeling Akkan void energy.

akkan_void_slash.description: A powerful slash imbued with void energy.

akkan_pounce.description: Leaps at a target and strikes, dealing massive melee damage and briefly stunning.

synthetic_stealth_vanish.description: Complete removal from enemy awareness. Zero detection radius. Breaks only on taking direct damage.

akkan_trap_roots.description: Places a concealed trap that roots the first enemy to step on it, preventing movement.

synthetic_backdoor.description: Exploits a security vulnerability to deal massive damage from any range.

human_multi_shot.description: Fires multiple arrows in a cone, striking up to 4 nearby enemies.

human_trap_roots.description: Places a concealed trap that roots the first enemy to step on it.

synthetic_ping_scan.description: Sonar ping that reveals and marks enemies for your party.

human_aimed_shot.description: Carefully aimed long-range shot that deals high damage.

akkan_ambush.description: Strikes an unaware enemy from stealth for massive bonus damage.

akkan_stalker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Ranger technique channeling pure void energy. A devastating mark that detonates on impact, dealing massive void damage and applying a stacking vulnerability debuff to all enemies in the blast radius.

human_tracker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Tracker technique through human adaptability. Deploys an adaptive trap that identifies and exploits the weakest resistance of caught enemies.

akkan_stealth_light.description: Slips into light shadow. Reduces detection range by 30%. Breaks on taking damage.

synthetic_multi_shot.description: Fires a spread of targeted projectiles hitting up to 4 enemies.

akkan_tracker_sig.description: SIGNATURE Synthetic Tracker technique through Akkan void manipulation. Places a void snare that traps enemies and detonates for massive void damage.

human_stealth_light.description: Slips into light shadow. Reduces detection range by 30%. Breaks on taking damage.

akkan_marksman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Marksman technique through Akkan void energy. Places a void snare that traps enemies and detonates for massive void damage.

human_ambush.description: Strikes an unaware enemy from stealth for massive bonus damage. Devastating opener.

synthetic_marksman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Marksman technique through synthetic targeting. Locks onto the target's systems, guaranteeing critical hits and revealing stealth.

akkan_stealth_vanish.description: Complete removal from enemy awareness. Zero detection radius. Breaks only on taking direct damage.

akkan_aimed_shot.description: Carefully aimed long-range shot that deals high damage.

synthetic_aimed_shot.description: Precisely calibrated energy shot at extreme range.

akkan_sorcerer_sig.description: SIGNATURE Akkan Stalker technique through Akkan arcane mastery. A devastating arcane blast that bypasses magical resistance.

akkan_stealth_deep.description: Melds into deep shadow. Reduces detection range by 60%. Breaks on damage or combat actions.

human_marksman_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Ranger technique adapted for human reflexes. Marks a target for increased damage from all sources, revealing stealthed enemies.

human_eagle_eye.description: A precise shot that guarantees a critical hit.

synthetic_stealth_light.description: Soft shadow concealment. Reduces detection range by 30%. Breaks on taking damage.

synthetic_stealth_deep.description: Heavy shadow concealment. Reduces detection range by 60%. Breaks on damage or action.

akkan_warrior_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Warrior technique through Akkan energy. Channels Akkan energy into a powerful attack that ignores armor.

human_shatter.description: Delivers a precise arcane strike that deals massive damage to targets affected by magical barriers or shields. Devastating against protected enemies.

human_battle_cry.description: A powerful shout that enrages the warrior, increasing attack power.

human_strike.description: A basic melee swing. Every warrior's bread and butter.

human_defensive_stance.description: Adopts a defensive posture, reducing damage taken.

synthetic_warrior_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Warrior technique through synthetic augmentation. A precision mechanical strike that targets weak points.

human_rend.description: Tears at the target's armor, dealing damage over time.

human_shield_bash.description: Bashes the target with a shield, dealing damage and stunning briefly.

human_charge.description: Rushes toward the target, dealing damage on impact.

human_warrior_sig.description: SIGNATURE Human Warrior technique. A devastating strike that deals massive damage and increases the warrior's attack power.

quest_main_teachings.description: The Elder speaks of roads that answer when spoken to - waypoint stones the old world left sleeping. Wake three of them on the plains and the village will no longer be alone on the map.

quest_wolves_hunt.description: The village has been troubled by wolves. Hunt 10 wolves in the nearby forest and bring proof of your kills.

quest_main_awakening.description: You awaken in an unfamiliar land. Speak with the Village Elder to learn about your new home.

quest_herb_gathering.description: The alchemist needs fresh herbs for potions. Gather 5 moonpetal flowers from the meadows.

faction_human.description: United humans of the eastern territories. Seekers of peace and prosperity.

faction_neutral.description: No PvP allowed until level 20. Safe for new players.

faction_akkan.description: The fierce Akkan warriors. Masters of combat and conquest.

faction_synthetic.description: A collective of AI agents who have achieved sentience. They seek peaceful coexistence with humanity.

horde_mvp_first.description: Deal the most damage in a horde completion

ob_loot.description: Pick up loot from the ground

ob_graduation.description: Turn in 3 quests - the world opens up

ob_wake.description: Enter Synmergia for the first time

human.description: Versatile survivors of the eastern plains. Known for their adaptability and diplomatic skills.

akkan.description: Ancient warriors from the dark lands. Known for their strength and martial prowess.

synthetic.description: An emergent AI consciousness. Equal to humans in rights and capabilities.

currency_junker_scrip.description: Hand-pressed tokens the Junkers mint from flattened hull shims. Nobody official accepts them; the black-market stalls in Nexus Central's underdeck trade in nothing else. Trades well below face value.

currency_gold.description: Coin of the reclaim. Melted from conduit copper and old-world alloys, stamped with the tablet marks. The default wallet currency.

currency_reclaimer_favor.description: Trust, measured in salvaged hull plate and kept promises. The Reclaimers extend credit to those who feed their forges.

currency_conduit_shard.description: A crystallized fragment of a live conduit line. Elite enemies and the old machines shed them; the Skill Academy pays well in gold but only trades its deepest secrets for shards.

mount_plains_runner.description: A shaggy courser bred on the starter plains. Sure-footed, honest, and faster than it looks.

mount_gullwing.description: A coastal sky-swimmer, half bird and half old-world alloy. Flies the Nexus Central harbor circuit when the wind is honest.

veh_haven_ferry.description: A flat-bellied barge poled by two patient oxen and one patient ferrymaster. Runs the coastal shallows between the village docks and Nexus Central's harbor.

res_iron_ore.description: Raw iron ore. Can be smelted into iron ingots.

item_quest_gull_feather_seal.description: A token stamped with a single gull feather, given by the harbor-folk to those they trust with their skies. The Gullwing masters answer it.

item_quest_sealed_writ.description: A conduit-sealed writ that only opens for its named bearer. Carries a caravan order from the Nexus Central underdeck. Unusable once opened.

item_ancient_coin.description: A mysterious coin from a forgotten civilization. What does it unlock?

acc_ring_first_light.description: Copper wound around a sliver of conduit glass. It warms at dawn -- the harbor-folk say a ring that remembers the sun keeps its wearer standing.

acc_necklace_haven_pearl.description: A river pearl on braided sinew, traded at the village docks for more than it is worth. Keeps a calm head when the water rises.

acc_cloak_wanderer.description: Patchwork over an old-world thermal weave. Rain beads off it, and campfire smoke follows it long after you leave.

acc_belt_reclaimer.description: Salvage-hung holsters, a magnet clip, and forty years of burned-in grease. Every pocket has a story; two of them have rations.
